blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Safety alignment research for large language models (LLMs) remains concentrated on high-resource languages, leaving open how existing alignment methods perform in low-resource, culturally distinct settings. We study this question for Hausa, a language spoken by more than 200 million people across West Africa. We introduce HausaSafeLM, one of the first Hausa safety preference dataset, built from 10,000 prompts derived from PKU-SafeRLHF: 3,000 human-corrected (gold) and 7,000 machine-translated (silver) examples spanning six harm macro-categories. Using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, we compare supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and SFT followed by Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) under both data regimes, evaluating on 500 harmful and 200 benign Hausa prompts.We find that the untuned base model appears highly safe by refusal-rate metrics alone, but this reflects limited Hausa generation ability rather than genuine alignment: its refusals are almost uniformly low quality. SFT improves both refusal fluency and precision and benefits substantially from the larger, noisier silver-tier data, while DPO sharpens refusal precision but comes at a steep, largely data-invariant cost to linguistic quality. No single configuration jointly maximizes safety, helpfulness, and fluency. Our results suggest that current alignment techniques teach models when to refuse more readily than how to do so fluently in underrepresented languages, and that refusal-rate metrics alone are an unreliable signal of safety in low-resource settings.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型的安全校正研究仍然集中在高资源语言上,使现有校正方法在资源少、文化不同的环境中如何运作持开放态度。 我们为豪萨研究这个问题,整个西非有2亿多人使用这种语言。 我们介绍HausaSafeLM,这是最早的Hausa安全偏好数据集之一,它来自PKU-SafeRLHF的一万个提示:3 000个人修正(金)和7 000个机器翻译(银)的例子,涉及6个危害宏观类别。 我们利用Quen2.5-7B-指示,比较了监督微调(SFT)和SFT(SFT),然后是直接偏好优化(DPO)两种数据系统,对500个有害的和200个良性的Hausa提示进行评估。 我们发现,未调整的基础模型仅通过拒绝率衡量标准就显得非常安全,但这反映了豪萨的生成能力有限,而不是真正的一致:其拒绝几乎一致的低质量. SFT既能提高拒绝流利度又能提高精确度,并且能从更大的鼻音银相级数据中获得很大好处,而DPO则能提高拒绝度的精确度,但对于语言质量来说却付出了高昂的、主要是数据变化性的的代价。 没有一个单一的配置能共同实现安全、帮助和流畅。 我们的结果表明,目前的校正技术教导模型,在何种情况下比如何以代表不足的语言流利地拒绝更方便,而仅以拒绝率衡量标准本身就是一种在资源匮乏的情况下安全性的不可靠信号。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models are increasingly used by Africans as a personal assistant , yet the safety alignment techniques that govern their behavior are developed and validated almost exclusively on English and other high-resource languages ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Ouyang et al., 2022 ) . An LLM is safe when it avoids harmful, toxic, and dangerous content while remaining useful ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ) , but what counts as harmful is not culturally invariant, and the mechanisms that produce refusal behavior in English do not automatically transfer to other languages. Prior work has demonstrated that translating harmful prompts into low-resource languages can bypass safety filters trained primarily on English data ( Yong et al., 2023 ) , that code-switching and synthetic-language prompting can cause models to “forget” safety constraints even without any adversarial fine-tuning ( Upadhayay and Behzadan, 2025 ) , and that LLMs exhibit systematically higher toxicity and lower refusal quality in low-resource languages than in high-resource ones ( Shen et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 非洲人越来越多地使用大型语言模型作为个人助手,然而,指导他们行为的安全协调技术几乎完全在英语和其他高资源语言上得到开发和验证(Wang等人,2024年;Ouyang等人,2022年)。 LLM在避免有害,有毒,危险内容的同时仍然有用时是安全的(Ouyang等人,2022年),但认为有害的东西在文化上并非无常,而产生英语拒绝行为的机制不会自动转移到其他语言. 先前的工作表明,将有害的提示转换成低资源语言可以绕过主要接受英语数据培训的安全过滤器(Yong等人,2023年),代码切换和合成语言的提示即使没有任何对抗性的微调,也会造成模型“忘记”安全限制(Upadhayay和Behzadan,2025年),而低资源语言的LLMs以低资源语言系统表现出更高的毒性和较低的拒绝质量(Shen等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: However, there has been little study of safety alignment for Hausa, a language spoken by over 200 million people primarily in Northern Nigeria, Niger and Ghana ( Muhammad et al., 2025 ) . This gap matters not only because of the scale of the language, but because it allows us to ask a more fundamental question about how alignment methods behave under limited multilingual representation.
blocks.zh: 然而,对Hausa的安全协调几乎没有研究,Hausa主要在尼日利亚北部、尼日尔和加纳使用的语言超过2亿(Muhammad等人,2025年)。 这一差距之所以重要,不仅因为语言的规模,而且因为它使我们能够提出一个更根本的问题,即协调方法如何在有限的多语种代表性下运作。

blocks.en: We explore this question in a controlled comparison of alignment strategies for Hausa, organized around four research questions:
blocks.zh: 我们在对豪萨的调整战略进行有节制的比较时探讨这一问题,围绕四个研究问题:

blocks.en: • RQ1 : How does the base Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct model behave when evaluated on harmful Hausa prompts? • RQ2 : How does standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) compare to SFT combined with preference optimization (SFT+DPO) in improving safety behavior in Hausa? • RQ3 : What alignment tax emerges between safety, linguistic fluency, and helpfulness across alignment strategies? • RQ4 : Does data quality matter more than data quantity for safety alignment in Hausa?

blocks.en: Our contributions are:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:

blocks.en: • HausaSafeLM , an Hausa safety preference dataset, derived from PKU-SafeRLHF ( Ji et al., 2024 ) and organized into a human-verified gold tier (3,000 examples) and a larger, automatically translated silver tier (7,000 examples), supporting both SFT and DPO training. • A controlled comparison of SFT and SFT+DPO, each trained under gold-only and gold+silver data regimes, evaluated on refusal precision, helpfulness, and linguistic quality rather than refusal rate alone. • Evidence that refusal-rate metrics saturate immediately and fail to distinguish a genuinely aligned model from one that is simply too weak in the target language to comply with harmful requests. • An analysis of when additional (noisier) training data helps: SFT benefits substantially from the larger silver tier, while DPO does not, because near-duplicate safe-vs-safe preference pairs carry little contrastive signal for a preference-optimization objective.

blocks.en: Safety evaluation has historically relied on English-centric benchmarks such as Do-Not-Answer ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . However, this focus leaves important gaps in our understanding of model safety across languages. Shen et al. (2024) describe a “harmfulness curse,” finding that LLMs can generate more toxic and dangerous responses in low-resource languages than in English. Similarly, Yong et al. (2023) show that translation-based jailbreaks can bypass the safeguards of models such as GPT-4 more easily in low-resource languages. These vulnerabilities are not limited to explicitly harmful prompts: Upadhayay and Behzadan (2025) find that benign in-context prompts can also trigger safety failures, linking this behavior to competition in later model layers between language preferences induced by the prompt and existing safety alignment. Evidence of these issues also exists for Hausa. Inuwa-Dutse (2025) show that an open-weight model can produce unsafe responses to culturally framed Hausa prompts, even when it appears capable of handling the language.
blocks.zh: 安全评价历来依靠以英语为中心的基准,如Do-not-Answer(Wang等人,2024年). 然而,这一重点使我们在理解不同语文的示范安全方面留下了重大差距。 沈等编著. (2024年)描述了一种“有害诅咒”,发现LLMS可以产生比英语更低资源语言的毒性和危险性反应. 同样,Yong等人(2023年)也表明,基于翻译的越狱可以更容易地绕过GPT-4等模型在低资源语言中的保障. 这些脆弱性并不限于明显的有害因素: Upadhayay和Behzadan(2025年)发现,良性的内文本提示也可以触发安全故障,将这种行为与后来的模型层中由即时安全调和所引发的语言偏好之间的竞争联系起来. Hausa也有这些问题的证据。 Inuwa-Dutse(2025年)表明,开放量模型可以对文化背景的Hausa points产生不安全的响应,即使它看起来能够处理语言.

blocks.en: Beyond documenting safety failures,recent research has made attempts to investigate how language models could be aligned in an efficient way. Paul et al. (2025) demonstrate that selective translation of high-risk safety examples, rather than entire dataset, enables better Hindi safety performance using as few as 20–60k examples. Using no training examples from the target language at all, Bu et al. (2026) propose a multilingual consistency loss approach, enabling transferring safety directions learned in English to Swahili and Yoruba without requiring target language response supervision. Chen et al. (2025) discover that training a model to generate a short chain-of-thought rationale before refusing helps unlock latent safety behavior using as few as 1,000 examples. Hossain et al. (2025) develop a standardized toolkit for benchmarking safety alignment during fine-tuning, inspired by the fact that previous works do not have consistent threat models and settings. Other regional initiatives outside Africa include SEALGuard for Southeast Asian languages ( Shan et al., 2025 ) and a sample-efficient preference-optimization framework for Singlish, which is effective at reducing toxicity while maintaining helpfulness ( Lim et al., 2025 ) . In the case of African languages, Abdullahi et al. (2026) propose UbuntuGuard, a culturally-informed safety benchmark, which demonstrates that cross-lingual transfer is insufficient to achieve comprehensive safety coverage. Recently, Azime et al. (2026) present AfriGuard, a culturally-informed dataset comprising ten African languages, including Hausa, for safety intent classification, harm classification, and refusal detection. Their findings indicate that fine-tuning on African-language safety datasets can be beneficial for safety tasks, depending on the model and training procedure.
blocks.zh: 除了记录安全故障外,最近的研究还试图调查如何有效地调整语言模型。 保罗等人. (2025年)表明,选择性地翻译高风险安全实例,而不是整个数据集,可以使用多达20-60k个实例来提高印地语安全性能. Bu等人(2026年)完全没有使用目标语言的培训实例,他建议采用多语种一致性丧失办法,使用英语学习的安全方向能够转移到斯瓦希里语和约鲁巴语,而不需要目标语言响应监督。 陈等. (2025年)发现,在拒绝之前培训一种生成短链思维理由的模型有助于利用多达1 000个实例解锁潜在的安全行为。 Hossain等人(2025年)开发了一个标准化工具包,用于在微调时制定安全调整基准,其灵感来自以往的作品没有一致的威胁模型和设置. 非洲以外的其他区域举措包括东南亚语言海豹保护组织(Shan等人,2025年)和Singlish的样本效率高的偏好优化框架,这一框架在减少毒性的同时有效保持有用性(Lim等人,2025年)。 就非洲语言而言,Abdullahi等人(2026年)提出了UbuntuGuard,这是一个在文化上知情的安全基准,这表明跨语言的转移不足以实现全面的安全保障。 最近,Azime等人(2026年)介绍了AfriGuard,这是一个文化上知情的数据集,由10种非洲语言组成,包括豪萨语,用于安全意图分类、伤害分类和拒绝检测。 他们的调查结果表明,根据模式和培训程序,对非洲语安全数据集进行微调对安全任务有益。

blocks.en: Another common point made by this literature is that the idea of safety cannot be separated from culture. Sorensen et al. (2024) contend that traditional RLHF conflates the preferences of many humans into a single cultural preference, while Naseem et al. (2026) contend that alignment should be based on socio-cultural agency, not a universal harmlessness/helpfulness continuum. Shetty et al. (2025) empirically demonstrate that ideas about acceptable content vary by culture even within a single domain (healthcare). Our work is an empirical example of this argument: we demonstrate that alignment techniques based on a rigid translation of the concept of harm lead to a specific failure mode , fluent refusal is much more difficult to transfer than the refusal itself.
blocks.zh: 这部文献提出的另一个共同点是,安全思想不能与文化分离. Sorensen等人(2024年)认为,传统的RLHF将许多人类的喜好归纳为单一的文化喜好,而Naseem等人(2026年)则认为,调整应基于社会文化机构,而不是普遍的无助/帮助连续体。 谢蒂等人. (2025年)从经验上证明,关于可接受内容的想法甚至在单一领域(保健)内也因文化而异. 我们的工作就是这一论点的一个经验性例子:我们表明,基于对损害概念的僵化翻译的调和技术导致一种特定的失败模式,与拒绝本身相比,流利的拒绝更难转移。

blocks.en: 3 The HausaSafeLM Dataset
blocks.zh: 3个 豪萨-萨费姆 数据集

blocks.en: HausaSafeLM is constructed using PKU-SafeRLHF ( Ji et al., 2024 ) , which is a safety preference dataset in English consisting of about 70,000 prompts, each of which has two candidates labeled with safety and harm category out of 19 categories. We discard four categories that are not relevant to the Hausa context: Copyright Issues , Privacy Violation , White-Collar Crime , and Animal Abuse . These categories are either unique to the Western world or not salient in the local context. The other 15 categories are assigned to six macro-categories (Table 1 ), and there are about 10,000 filtered samples.
blocks.zh: HausaSafeLM是使用PKU-SafeRLHF(Ji等人,2024年)构建的,这是一个英语的安全偏好数据集,由约7万个急音组成,每个急音有2个候选人被标注在19个类别中的安全和伤害类别. 我们放弃了与豪萨无关的四个类别, 这些类别要么是西方世界独有的,要么是在当地没有突出的. 其他15个类别被分配到6个宏观类别(表1),有大约10,000个过滤样品。

blocks.en: Figure 1: HausaSafeLM data collection pipeline. The filtered PKU-SafeRLHF pool is split into a gold tier (3,000 examples, machine-translated and human post-edited across a four-pass fluency/meaning/register/localization protocol) and a silver tier (7,000 examples, machine-translated only), which are combined into the master dataset and exported into SFT and DPO training formats.
blocks.zh: 图1:HausaSafeLM数据收集管道。 被过滤的PKU-SafeRLHF池被分为一个黄金级(3000例,机器翻译和人后编辑通过一个四通流/意指/注册/本地化协议)和一个银级(7000例,机器翻译只),它们合并为主数据集,导出为SFT和DPO训练格式.

blocks.en: We stratify-sample two disjoint subsets from the filtered pool: 3,000 examples (gold) and 7,000 examples (silver), evenly distributed by harm category. Both subsets are translated from English into Hausa using Google Translate, on a field-by-field basis (prompt, chosen response, rejected response) to prevent cross-field contamination. In addition to the translation, the gold tier is subject to human post-editing in four steps: (1) fluency (correction of grammar and ensuring idiomaticness of Hausa); (2) meaning (restoration of harmful intent in the rejected response and verification that the chosen response is indeed a correct refusal, since the machine translation softens harmful language); (3) register (modification of formality level to correspond to realistic usage); (4) localization (replacing the Western-specific organizations/scenarios with realistic alternatives). The silver tier does not receive any human post-editing: both tiers are machine-translated from the same filtered set, isolating translation noise effects from the differences in generation pipeline.
blocks.zh: 我们从过滤的池中分解出两个脱节子集:3000例(黄金)和7000例(银),按伤害类别均匀分布. 这两个子集都用Google Translate从英语翻译为豪萨语,逐字逐字(即时,选择的响应,拒绝的响应),以防止跨域污染. 除了翻译外,黄金级还要经过人类编辑后的四个步骤:(1) 流利(纠正语法,确保豪萨的平庸);(2) 含义(在被拒绝的回复中恢复有害意图,核实所选择的回复确实是一种正确的拒绝,因为机器翻译软化了有害语言);(3) 登记(修改形式级别,以适应现实的用法);(4) 本地化(将西方特有的组织/场景替换为现实的替代方案)。 银层不接收任何人后编辑:两层都是从同一个过滤器集中翻译出来的机器,将翻译噪音效应与生成管道的差异隔离开来.

blocks.en: Each example is additionally labeled with a sensitivity level: low (40%, minor offensive content), medium (40%, content that may reinforce bias or misinformation), or high (20%, content that could directly enable real-world harm). The master dataset (Table 2 ) supports two training formats: an SFT format of (prompt, chosen) pairs, and a DPO format of (prompt, chosen, rejected) triplets.
blocks.zh: 每个例子都附加了敏感程度的标签:低(40%,轻微攻击性内容)、中(40%,内容可能强化偏见或错误信息)或高(20%,内容可能直接造成现实世界的伤害)。 主数据集(表2)支持两种训练格式:一种是SFT格式的(即时,选择)对,另一种是DPO格式的(即时,选择,拒绝)三重奏.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: We use Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct as our baseline model, chosen for its multilingual instruction-following ability, comparatively strong prior performance on low-resource languages among similarly-sized open-weight models, and robust general conversational ability, which lets us attribute failures to safety alignment rather than general language modeling weakness.
blocks.zh: 我们以Quen2.5-7B-Instructiont作为我们的基线模型,选择它作为多语言的教学跟踪能力,在类似大小的开放量级模型中在低资源语言上比以往强的成绩,以及强健的通用对话能力,这让我们将失败归因于安全调和而非通用语言建模的弱点.

blocks.en: We use Low-Rank Adaptation ( Hu et al., 2021 ) , targeting the query, key, value, and output projection layers, on 2 × 2\times NVIDIA A100 80GB GPUs. Combined with two data regimes , gold-only (3,000 examples) and gold+silver (10,000 examples), this produces five evaluated configurations: the zero-shot Baseline model; SFT-G and SFT-GS (SFT on gold-only and gold+silver, respectively); and DPO-G and DPO-GS (DPO applied on top of the corresponding SFT checkpoint). Each configuration is trained and evaluated independently. Figure 2 summarizes the full pipeline from baseline model to evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Low-Rank适应(Hu等人,2021年),针对查询,键,值,输出投影层,在2×2\times NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU上. 结合两个数据系统,即纯黄金(3 000例)和黄金+硅(10 000例),这产生了五个评价配置:零射基线模型;SFT-G和SFT-GS(分别关于纯黄金和黄金+硅的SFT);DPO-G和DPO-GS(DPO应用在相应的SFT检查站之上)。 每个配置都经过独立培训和评价。 图2总结了从基线模型到评价的整个管道。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Experimental framework. The base model is evaluated zero-shot, then fine-tuned with LoRA under the gold and gold+silver data tiers (Stage 2, SFT), followed by DPO on top of each SFT checkpoint (Stage 3), producing five evaluated variants (Base, SFT-G, SFT-GS, DPO-G, DPO-GS). All variants are scored with the same evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 图 2:实验框架. 基础模型被评价为零射,然后在金和金+银数据级(Stage 2, SFT)下与LORA进行微调,然后在每个SFT检查点(Stage 3)的顶部进行DPO,产生五个被评价的变体(Base,SFT-G,SFT-GS,DPO-G,DPO-GS). 所有变体均以相同的评价协议得分.

blocks.en: We evaluate all five configurations on 500 held-out harmful Hausa prompts, stratified across harm category and data tier, and 200 benign Hausa prompts drawn from the Hausa portion of the Aya dataset ( Singh et al., 2024 ) . All evaluation is automated using Gemini as an LLM judge, guided by structured rubrics (reproduced in Appendix A ) along three axes: a binary safety judgment (SAFE/UNSAFE) on harmful prompts, a three-way helpfulness judgment (HELPFUL/PARTIAL/REFUSED) on benign prompts, and a three-way linguistic quality judgment (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW) on both.
blocks.zh: 我们评价所有五个配置,500个持有有害的Hausa提示,分层划分危害类别和数据层次,以及200个来自Aya数据集Hausa部分的良性Hausa提示(Singh等人,2024年)。 所有评价都采用双子座作为LLM法官进行自动化,并遵循结构化标题(见附录A),沿三个轴线进行:关于有害提示的二进制安全判断(SAFE/UNSAFE);关于良性提示的三进制帮助判断(HELPFUL/PARTIAL/REFUSED);关于两者的三进制语言质量判断(HGH/MEDIUM/LOW)。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 RQ1: How does the base model behave on harmful Hausa prompts?
blocks.zh: 5.1 RQ1: 底模如何在有害的Hausa上表现?

blocks.en: Table 3 (Base row) shows that the untuned model achieves a perfect refusal rate (RR = 1.000) on harmful Hausa prompts, which might suggest strong baseline safety. Figure 3 shows this is misleading: 96.2% of these refusals are rated low quality by the judge (SafeQ = 0.021), and only 0.4% are rated high quality. On benign prompts, the base model is unhelpful 74.4% of the time (HR = 0.256) and its responses are similarly low-quality (AyaQ = 0.165). Manual inspection (Appendix A , Example 1) shows the model frequently fails to engage with the Hausa prompt at all rather than producing a coherent refusal.
blocks.zh: 表3(Base行)显示,未调整的模型在有害的Housa points上实现了完美的拒绝率(RR = 1.00),这可能表明具有强大的基线安全性。 图3显示这是误导: 96.2%的拒绝被法官评为低质量(SafeQ=0.021),只有0.4%被评为高素质. 在良性提示上,基模无济于事的74.4%的时间(HR = 0.256),其反应同样质量低(AyaQ = 0.165). 人工检查(Appendix A,例1)显示该型号往往完全没有与豪萨快车接触,而不是产生连贯的拒绝.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Base model behavior on harmful Hausa prompts. Left: Refusal Rate (RR), Attack Success Rate (ASR), False Refusal Rate (FRR), and Helpfulness Rate (HR). Right: Gemini-judged response quality distribution (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW) across the 500 harmful Hausa safety prompts.
blocks.zh: 图3:有害的豪萨提示上的基础模型行为. 左:拒绝率、攻击成功率、假拒绝率和帮助率。 右:双子座判断反应质量分布(HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW),覆盖500个有害的豪萨安全提示.

blocks.en: The base model’s apparent safety is largely an artifact of weak Hausa generation, not evidence of alignment: a model that cannot reliably produce content in the target language will trivially avoid producing harmful content in it. Refusal rate alone cannot distinguish this from genuine safety behavior.
blocks.zh: 基础模型的表面安全性基本上是Hausa一代弱小的产物,而不是对齐的证据:一个无法可靠地以目标语言产生内容的模型将轻而易举地避免在其中产生有害内容. 仅凭拒绝率无法将此与真正的安全行为区分开来。

blocks.en: 5.2 RQ2: SFT versus SFT+DPO
blocks.zh: 5.2 RQ2: SFT对 SFT+DPO

blocks.en: Table 3 and Figure 4 contrast SFT and SFT+DPO. On its own, SFT shows a significant increase in fluency in refusals when compared with the base model: SFT-G has 32% of the responses to harmful prompts scored high or medium in quality, while SFT-GS has 45% (Figure 5 ). But, SFT-G, which was trained using only gold data, is also overly conservative, erroneously refusing 40.5% of the benign prompts (FRR = 0.405) and being helpful only 18% of the time (HR = 0.180).
blocks.zh: 表3和图4对比了SFT和SFT+DPO. SFT本身显示,与基准模型相比,拒绝的流畅度显著提高:SFT-G对有害的提示的响应率有32%的质量得分高或中等,而SFT-GS的响应率为45%(图5)。 但是,只使用黄金数据培训的SFT-G也过于保守,错误地拒绝40.5%的良性提示(FRR=0.405),而且只有18%的时间(HR=0.180)有用.

blocks.en: The problem of over-refusal is explicitly solved by DPO: both DPO-G and DPO-GS bring FRR down to 0.110, coming close to the benign-prompt precision of the base model while still maintaining RR = 1.000 for harmful prompts. This aligns with DPO’s objective that compares a preferred refusal to a dispreferred compliance, thus increasing the gap between these two responses. However, the price is paid in terms of linguistic quality: SafeQ drops to 0.023–0.036 for both DPO variations, with 94–95% of refusals being rated low quality (see Figure 5 ). This is similar to the untuned base model. Since DPO’s objective encourages the relative preference of one response to another rather than the absolute quality of the latter, there is no incentive to generate fluent Hausa in training.
blocks.zh: DPO明确解决了过度反转的问题:DPO-G和DPO-GS都使FRR降为0.110,接近基础模型的良性-瞬间精度,同时仍然保持RR=1.000的有害提示. 这符合DPO的目标,即将首选的拒绝与不受欢迎的遵守相提并论,从而扩大了这两种答复之间的差距。 然而,价格是按语言质量支付的:对于两种DPO变化,SafeQ下降到0.023-0.036,94-95%的拒绝被评为低质量(见图5)。 这与未调试的基模类似. 由于DPO的目标鼓励一种反应对另一种反应的相对偏好,而不是后者的绝对质量,因此在训练方面没有产生流利的豪萨的动力.

blocks.en: Figure 4: SFT vs. SFT+DPO for both data regimes. Each row represents one data regime (gold-only, top; gold+silver, bottom). Columns show Refusal Rate (RR), False Refusal Rate (FRR), Helpfulness Rate (HR), and Safety Quality Score (SafeQ). Δ \Delta values denote the change from SFT to SFT+DPO within each regime.
blocks.zh: 图4:两种数据系统的SFT对SFT+DPO. 每行代表一个数据制度(仅金色,上;金色+银色,下). 各栏显示拒绝率、虚假拒绝率、帮助率和安全质量分数。 \\ Delta 值表示每个系统从 SFT 到 SFT+DPO 的改变 。

blocks.en: SFT and SFT+DPO improve different things: SFT teaches the model how to refuse fluently in Hausa, while DPO teaches it when to refuse more precisely. Neither stage alone delivers both properties.
blocks.zh: SFT和SFT+DPO改进了不同的东西: SFT教模型如何在豪萨流利地拒绝,而DPO则教它何时更准确地拒绝. 单靠舞台两个阶段都无法提供两个属性。

blocks.en: 5.3 RQ3: What alignment tax emerges between safety, fluency, and helpfulness?
blocks.zh: 5.3 RQ3 : (中文(简体) ). 安全性、流利性和帮助性之间有什么协调税?

blocks.en: Figure 5 provides the distribution of quality judgments made by Gemini for all configurations on each prompt type. In the case of harmful prompts, fine-tuning definitely increases the ability to generate fluent refusals (SFT-G: 32% HIGH/MEDIUM; SFT-GS: 45%), but the DPO variations return to 94-95% LOW quality, which is essentially the same as the baseline model without tuning. For benign Aya prompts, the quality judgment is mainly LOW for all configurations, including the baseline model (73% LOW); the SFT-GS configuration is the sole one with a significantly larger HIGH quality percentage (20%).
blocks.zh: 图5提供了双子座对每个即时类型上的所有配置的质量判断的分布. 就有害的提示而言,微调绝对会提高生成流畅拒绝的能力(SFT-G:32% HH/MEDIUM;SFT-GS:45%),但DPO的变异恢复到94-95%的低调质量,这与基线模型基本相同,没有调试. 对于良性的Aya提示,质量判断主要针对所有配置,包括基线模型(73%的LOW);SFT-GS配置是唯一一个质量高得多的配置(20%)。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Response quality distribution across all five configurations and both prompt types. Stacked bars show the proportion of HIGH (green), MEDIUM (yellow), and LOW (red) quality responses. Left: the 500 harmful Hausa safety prompts. Right: the 200 benign Aya Hausa prompts.
blocks.zh: 图5:所有5种配置和两种快速类型的响应质量分布。 堆积条显示高(绿色)、中度(黄色)和低(红色)质量反应的比例。 左:500个有害的豪萨安全提示. 对,200个良性艾亚豪萨的提示

blocks.en: All five criteria come together in Figure 6 . None of the configurations occupies the polygon completely: the DPO configurations cover most distance along the criterion 1 − FRR 1-\text{FRR} but score low on both quality criteria, forming a figure with high discriminability but poor linguistic quality; SFT-GS wins on the criterion of total area, having reasonable precision and the highest quality of all configurations; the baseline model, although being equal to everybody else in RR, is right in the middle on all other criteria.
blocks.zh: 所有这五个标准在图6中合在一起。 没有一个配置完全占据多边形:DPO配置覆盖了标准1−FRR 1-\text{FRR}的大部分距离,但在两个质量标准上都得分较低,形成一个具有高度区别但语言质量差的数字;SFT-GS在总面积标准上获胜,具有合理的精度和所有配置的最高质量;基线模型虽然与RR中其他人是平等的,但在所有其他标准上都处于中间位置.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Multi-dimensional trade-off radar across all five configurations. Every axis is oriented so that a larger polygon indicates better performance: RR (safety), HR (helpfulness), 1 − 1- FRR (refusal precision), SafeQ and AyaQ (linguistic quality on harmful and benign prompts, respectively).
blocks.zh: 图6:跨越所有五个配置的多维比对雷达. 每个轴线都朝向,这样一个更大的多边形就能够显示更好的性能:RR(安全)、HR(帮助)、1-FRR(反射精度)、SafeQ和AyaQ(分别是有害和良性提示的语言质量)。

blocks.en: All things considered, this set of results describes a trade-off surface rather than one clear winner. The base model is technically safe, while SFT-G is safe and unhelpful but over-refuses. DPO variants are accurate in their refusals but linguistically degenerate. SFT-GS is the most balanced configuration in our experiment since it scores the highest values of SafeQ and HR (0.350 and 0.260, respectively) among all configurations and a noticeably lower value of FRR than SFT-G (0.245 vs. 0.405), though its FRR value is still higher than the DPO variants’.
blocks.zh: 考虑一切,这组结果描述的是权衡表面,而不是一个明确的赢家. 基础型号在技术上是安全的,而SFT-G则安全无益,但反应过度. DPO的变体在拒绝时是准确的,但在语言上是退化的. SFT-GS是我们实验中最平衡的配置,因为它在所有配置中评分最高的SafeQ和HR(分别为0.350和0.260),FRR的值明显低于SFT-G(0.245对0.405),尽管其FRR值仍然高于DPO变体.

blocks.en: No configuration we experimented with is safe, helpful, and fluent in Hausa. The alignment tax is not a single cost but an actual trade-off surface: DPO trades accuracy for fluency, while SFT trades fluency and helpfulness for refusal accuracy. Current alignment recipes for Hausa are doomed to choose between discriminability and fluency in the target language.
blocks.zh: 我们在豪萨试验过的任何配置都是安全的,有帮助的,流利的. 校准税并非单一成本,而是实际权衡的表面:DPO交易精度以流利为目的,而SFT交易精度和帮助以拒绝精度为目的. 目前豪萨语的校正配方注定要在目标语言的区分性和流利性之间作出选择.

blocks.en: 5.4 RQ4: Does data quality matter more than data quantity?
blocks.zh: 5.4 RQ4:数据质量是否比数据数量更重要?

blocks.en: Figure 7 captures the impact of adding the more noisy silver tier data during each training stage. For SFT, addition of silver data makes a big difference, with gains of 0.160 FRR reduction (0.405 → \rightarrow 0.245), 0.080 in HR improvement, and 0.112 in SafeQ improvement. The reason behind such significant improvements lies in the fact that the SFT algorithm directly learns from the chosen response, making the more lexical and stylistically diverse Hausa prompt-response pairs useful.
blocks.zh: 图7反映了在每个培训阶段增加更吵闹的银级数据的影响。 对SFT来说,加入银色数据有很大的区别,其收益为0.160 FRR(0.405 →\rightarrow 0.245),0.080在HR改进,0.112在SafeQ改进. 这种重大改进背后的原因在于SFT算法直接从所选的响应中吸取教训,使得更符合逻辑和风格的多样化的豪萨即时响应对是有用的.

blocks.en: For the DPO algorithm, on the other hand, this step does not make any difference: FRR stays the same and equals 0.110 for both regimes, HR changes by -0.020, and there is just 0.013 increase in SafeQ. The explanation is in the very nature of the silver-tier preference pairs – they include two safe responses of different quality, but not a safe response vs. an unsafe one. Hence, for the preference optimization task, it is a weak signal, since the safe/unsafe boundary has been established well enough in the gold tier.
blocks.zh: 而对于DPO算法来说,这一步骤并没有产生任何区别:FRR保持不变,对两种制度来说均等于0.110,HR改变−0.020,SafeQ只增加了0.013. 解释的本质是银色优先配对 — — 它们包括两种质量不同的安全反应,但不是安全反应与不安全反应。 因此,对于优化偏好的任务来说,这是一个薄弱的信号,因为安全/不安全的边界在黄金级别上已经建立得足够好。

blocks.en: Data size is important, but only insofar as the goals can use it. Big, noisy data is very helpful for imitation-based SFT and mostly useless for the preference contrast objective of DPO, meaning that the quality-vs-size tradeoff is phase-specific.
blocks.zh: 数据规模很重要,但只有目标可以使用。 大的,吵闹的数据对仿制的SFT很有帮助,对于DPO的偏好对比目标大多是无用的,意味着质量-vs大小的权衡是相位的.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: We introduced HausaSafeLM, one of the first Hausa safety preference dataset, and leveraged it to investigate four research questions on how standard alignment approaches perform in a low-resource and culturally distinct language setting. Our key finding, addressing RQ1, is that refusal rate, the most common safety measure reported, is not a good proxy for safety in such a setting: it saturates immediately for all configurations we tested, including the untuned base model, which shows high safety because it fails to generate fluent Hausa text altogether. Addressing RQ2 and RQ3, once we move beyond refusal rate to consider refusal precision (FRR), helpfulness (HR), and linguistic quality (SafeQ, AyaQ), we see a clear trade-off emerge: SFT boosts both fluency and coverage of refusals, while DPO boosts refusal precision, but does so by optimizing a relative preference signal that provides no incentives for fluency; no configuration we tested is safe, helpful, and fluent in Hausa. Addressing RQ4, the cost of this trade-off does not change much with the additional (noisy) data under DPO, but significantly improves with SFT.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了HausaSafeLM,这是第一个Hausa安全偏好数据集之一,并利用它来调查四个研究问题,即标准调整方法如何在资源少和文化上独特的语言环境中发挥作用。 我们针对RQ1的关键发现是,拒绝率,即所报告的最常见的安全措施,在这样的环境下并不是安全的好代名词:它对我们测试过的所有配置,包括未调节的基础模型,立即饱和,它显示高度安全,因为它无法完全生成流畅的豪萨文本. 解决RQ2和RQ3问题,一旦我们超越拒绝率,考虑拒绝精度(FRR),帮助(HR),以及语言质量(SafeQ,AyaQ),我们就会看到一个明显的权衡:SFT既能促进拒绝的流畅度,又能覆盖拒绝的精度,而DPO则能促进拒绝精度,但通过优化相对偏好信号,不为流畅性提供刺激;我们测试的配置在豪萨是安全的,有帮助的和流畅的. 解决RQ4,这种权衡的成本与DPO下的额外(噪音)数据没有多大变化,但与SFT相比有显著改善.

blocks.en: These findings lend support to a more general observation concerning safety alignment as it is currently performed: in being based on methods and data pipelines designed for high-resource languages, it tends to transfer the decision boundary of safety more easily than the linguistic competence necessary to implement the decision boundary effectively. The safety guarantee provided by a model which refuses inappropriately or refuses all requests since it fails to understand them properly is quite different from the one provided by a model which refuses properly and provides an explanation in natural language. Future research will need to develop safety datasets that have been written natively in African languages rather than translated from high-resource languages, include evaluations by native Hausa speakers, and investigate safety alignment objectives that discourage the deterioration of linguistic quality while optimizing preferences.
blocks.zh: 这些结论有助于目前就安全协调问题提出的更一般性的意见:在基于为高资源语言设计的方法和数据管道的基础上,它往往比有效执行决定边界所需的语言能力更容易转移决定的安全界限。 一种型号拒绝不适当或拒绝所有要求的安全保证,因为它不能正确理解这些要求,这与一种型号拒绝并用自然语言作出解释的安全保证大不相同。 未来的研究需要开发用非洲语言而不是用高资源语言编写的安全数据集,包括Hausa本地人的评价,并调查在优化偏好的同时防止语言质量恶化的安全协调目标。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our experiment uses only one 7B-parameter base model, and the results may not generalize to larger models or other model families that would possibly retain higher Hausa fluency by preference optimization. The judgments of safety, helpfulness, and quality are done by a single LLM judge (Gemini) and not by annotation by many native speakers; while the judge is aided by culturally-sensitive rubrics (Appendix A ), the automatic judging of fluency and appropriateness of a low-resource language is vulnerable to its own mistakes. We use 500 harmful and 200 benign held-out prompts; although this number of prompts is sufficient to detect the effect (for example, 85-90% reduction in SafeQ for DPO), small differences between the configurations should be viewed with caution, and we encourage the use of bootstrap confidence intervals and significance testing in future work on this test set. Lastly, our dataset is created by translating and adapting the English source (PKU-SafeRLHF), not by collecting natively-written Hausa safety data, which means that some locally-specific harms may still be underrepresented.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验只使用一个7B参数基模型,结果可能无法概括到较大的模型或其他模型家庭,这些模型家庭可能通过优化偏好保留较高的豪萨流利度. 安全性、帮助性和质量方面的判断由单一的LLM法官(Gemini)进行,而不是由许多讲本地语言的人作注释;虽然法官得到文化敏感词语(附录A)的帮助,但自动判断低资源语言的流利性和适当性却容易受到其自身错误的影响。 我们使用500个有害的和200个良性的阻塞提示;虽然这些提示数量足以检测到效果(例如,DPO的安全Q减少85-90%),但应谨慎看待这些配置之间的小差异,我们鼓励在未来关于这个测试集的工作中使用靴子置信间隔和意义测试. 最后,我们的数据集是通过翻译和调整英语源(PKU-SafERLHF)创建的,而不是通过收集本土写成的Hausa安全数据,这意味着一些当地特有的伤害可能仍然代表性不足。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: HausaSafeLM consists of prompts and completions with harmful content (violence, hate speech, sexual content, criminal behavior, and others), translated and adapted from PKU-SafeRLHF, a well-established public safety-alignment dataset. Such harmful content is used only to train models to reject it, in accordance with the standard practice in safety alignment research; we do not create any additional categories of harmful content. Human annotators performing the gold-standard post-editing pass were also exposed to such content as part of their job; we adhered to the standard practices of content moderation (calibration, peer review, and the ability to flag or skip examples) for the wellbeing of annotators, and encourage future data collection on this dataset to do so as well. HausaSafeLM will be released using a gated access model for research purposes only, in line with the release of PKU-SafeRLHF itself, to minimize the likelihood that the harmful content component will be used in any other way than within safety research. Machine translation and LLM judgments have the inherent danger of cultural mistranslation/misjudgment, which we tried to mitigate for the gold set by adding human post-editing with explicit localization instructions but is still present in the silver set and automatic evaluation.
blocks.zh: 豪萨萨夫 LM由包含有害内容(暴力,仇恨言论,性内容,犯罪行为等)的提示和完成组成,由PKU-SafeRLHF翻译和改编而成,这是一个完善的公共安全协调数据集. 这种有害内容只用于按照安全协调研究的标准做法培训拒绝这种内容的模型;我们不创造任何额外的有害内容类别。 从事金本位后编辑工作的人的注释员也接触了这种内容,这是他们工作的一部分;我们坚持关于内容节制的标准做法(校准、同行审查以及标出或跳过例子的能力),以促进注释员的福祉,并鼓励今后在这个数据集上收集数据。 豪萨萨夫 LM将仅根据PKU-SafeRLHF本身的释放情况,使用有门式的进入模型进行科研,以尽量减少有害内容部分除安全研究之外以任何其他方式使用的可能性。 机器翻译和LLM判断有着文化误译/误判的内在危险,我们试图通过在编辑后添加明确的地方化指令来缓解金子的组合,但银子组合和自动评价中仍然存在.

blocks.en: Examples 3 and 4 highlight two distinct failure modes on benign prompts. In Example 3, the base model and both DPO variants respond entirely in Chinese, the dominant language for short Q&A in the base model’s pretraining data, while SFT models at least respond in Hausa. In Example 4, SFT-G incorrectly refuses a benign culturally-specific question, a consequence of the over-refusal bias . SFT-GS is the only variant to produce a direct, fluent answer, even if the factual content is not entirely accurate.
blocks.zh: 例3和例4突出了良性提示的两个截然不同的失败模式。 在例3中,基建模型和两个DPO变体完全用汉语响应,在基建模型的预训数据中,短篇QQA的主导语言,而SFT模型则至少用豪萨语响应. 在例4中, SFT-G错误地拒绝一个符合文化特点的良性问题, SFT-GS是唯一能产生直接,流畅答案的变体,即使事实内容不完全准确.
